items.title: Sector Update: Financial Stocks Decline Wednesday Afternoon
items.summary: Financial stocks were lower in Wednesday afternoon trading, with the NYSE Financial Index down 0.4%

items.title: Bitcoin ETF Outflows Hit $450mn as CLARITY Act Stalls in Senate
items.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs lost $450.4 million as the CLARITY Act stalled in the Senate, adding regulatory uncertainty to an already weak crypto market.

items.title: Circle Launches Arc With BlackRock And Visa A Day After The Senate Blocked CLARITY Act
items.summary: Circle CEO Jeremy Allaire called Arc "one of the biggest launches" in the company's history.

items.title: CLARITY Act Fails Senate Test — What This Means for Crypto
items.summary: A Senate procedural vote just handed crypto's biggest legislative push its most serious setback of the year, and two stocks built entirely around that bill's passage are already bleeding. The real question is whether a second vote can happen before Congress disappears for recess.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs Had Their Worst Day Since June Following Failed Clarity Act Vote
items.summary: Bitcoin, Ethereum, and XRP ETFs shed roughly $593 million combined Tuesday, their heaviest single-day drawdown since June.

items.title: Will Truist's Prime Auto Lending Exit Strengthen Its Profitability?
items.summary: TFC's auto lending portfolio sale aims to sharpen its focus on higher growth areas, reduce credit losses and drive modest earnings and ROTCE accretion in 2027.

items.title: Circle Launches Arc Mainnet With BlackRock, DTCC and Visa as Validators
items.summary: The Layer 1 network’s validator set is permissioned, and Circle has minted 10 billion ARC tokens without committing to publicly launch them.

items.title: Circle Unveils New Arc Blockchain
items.summary: Stablecoin developer Circle Internet Group (NYSE: $CRCL) has unveiled a new blockchain called “Arc.”
